key_findings: Nav1.8/Nav1.9 double knockout mice are viable with only mildly impaired acute pain behavior (higher noxious mechanical threshold; normal cold and innocuous mechanical sensitivity).
DKO DRGs show altered action potential shape, Penk upregulation, loss of C-LTMR markers and mild axonal degeneration.
